license: EditaLive code and LoRAs Apache-2.0, but the upstream README restricts use to academic research only; Wan2.2-Animate-14B Apache-2.0; Flash-VAED: no licence stated
notes: Upstream's live webcam path with the benchmark source as the camera: per chunk (9 source frames for the first chunk of a session, then 12) the upstream OnlineExtractor (YOLOv10m + ViTPose-H, ONNX Runtime TensorRT provider FP32) renders the pose skeleton and a 512x512 face crop from exactly those frames, and StreamingSession.push generates 3 latent frames (2 steps, timesteps [1000, 250], UniPC, shift 5, FP8 transformer, Flash-VAED decoder, dense attention = upstream's vsa_sparsity 0, torch.compile); extraction of the next chunk overlaps generation. The character is re-rendered from a reference frame: as upstream's Start editing, the first live frame of each session is the reference. Each text_control instruction is the prompt verbatim and starts a new session (upstream Reset + Prepare prompt + Start editing) on the next live frames. Source passed through until the first instruction. Landscape output only (upstream webcam): 672x384 (webcam default), centre crop of every source. Edits a person (accessories, garment / hair colour, styles); person-less frames are processed as upstream does (detector falls back to the whole frame). Text instructions only: reference_edit not registered.
